title: A game level from one sentence and two drawings
pitch: A place described in a sentence and two props drawn in. A real-scale beach, two meshes, and one pack with them placed, out.
why: World Kit builds the ground and buildings at real scale, Krea 2 draws the props, Hunyuan3D 2 builds them, and the pack places them in a scene an engine opens.

fields.label: The place
fields.default: a small sunny beach with a wooden pier

models.name: Blender
models.licence: GPL, runs as a separate tool

models.name: Krea 2
models.note: Read the terms before commercial use.

models.name: Hunyuan3D 2
models.note: Read its territory and use terms before relying on it.

models.name: ffmpeg
models.licence: LGPL/GPL, runs as a separate tool

tips: Hunyuan3D 2 builds shape only; colour comes later.

steps.label: The beach
steps.does: A real-scale place, built in Blender from the sentence.

steps.label: Art: barrel
steps.prompt: Stylised game prop concept art of a weathered wooden barrel with rope wrapped round it, a single object, the whole object in view, centred, three-quarter view, hand-painted texture, plain light grey studio background, soft even light. No text, no logos.

steps.label: Mesh: barrel
steps.does: Builds a mesh from one picture.

steps.label: Asset: barrel
steps.does: Real size, pivot at the base, a collider and a turntable, in Blender.

steps.label: Art: lifebuoy post
steps.prompt: Stylised game prop concept art of a wooden post with a red and white lifebuoy ring hanging on it, a single object, the whole object in view, centred, three-quarter view, hand-painted texture, plain light grey studio background, soft even light. No text, no logos.

steps.label: Mesh: post
steps.does: Builds a mesh from one picture.

steps.label: Asset: post
steps.does: Real size, pivot at the base, a collider and a turntable, in Blender.

steps.label: Level pack
steps.name: beach-level
steps.does: The place and props as glb files, a scene and a manifest, zipped.
